handoff.why_the_prior_demonstration_failed: RT-20260806-d008e0 OBJ-3 and VAL-20260806-bb0559 DEF-1 independently: the prior demonstration manipulated the ERROR LAW while the null the card declared removes the PROJECTOR's provenance. Under a Haar projector the marginal law of R is exactly Beta for ANY error law by rotation invariance, so the demonstration's expected contrast was exactly zero to leading order -- it could not have moved regardless of draw count. Separately (OBJ-4/DEF-3), the 4s threshold was expressed in the per-draw sd of the Haar arm, whose between-draw location variance is structurally near-zero (E[R|P] = beta/d deterministically under isotropic Sigma), making '4s' a ~2.0-2.5 sigma test rather than a 4 sigma one.
handoff.the_fix: MANIPULATE THE PROJECTOR, NOT THE ERROR LAW. Use the graded family Q_t = QR(sqrt(1-t) * E_S + sqrt(t) * G) where E_S is a random beta-subset coordinate selector (the first beta columns of a random permutation matrix) and G is a d x beta iid Gaussian matrix, both QR'd to orthonormal columns; t = 0 is coordinate-aligned, t = 1 is Haar. RT-20260806-d008e0 exhibited this family at d=100, beta=30 with 8 draws per t and found ratio_2em10 strictly decreasing across t in {0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00}: 1.09304, 1.08590, 1.07675, 1.05055, 1.01755, 1.00159, 1.00098. Re-derive this yourself as part of freezing the prediction -- do not copy the red team's numbers into the frozen file; they are a re-derivation offered by their author as 'not a run record', not an archived result.
handoff.threshold_fix: Declare the sensitivity threshold in units of the SE OF THE PAIRED DIFFERENCE of arm means at the declared draw count: SE = sqrt(sd_t0^2 + sd_haar^2 - 2*cov(t0,haar)) / sqrt(n_draws) if draws are paired on shared error vectors, or sqrt(sd_t0^2 + sd_haar^2)/sqrt(n_draws) if unpaired -- state which, and why, in the frozen file BEFORE running. Never use one arm's per-draw sd alone as the yardstick. Threshold: the t=0 arm must clear the Haar arm by >= 4 SE-of-the-difference.
additional_arms_required: unreduced q-ary tail GSO: the LAST beta coordinates of the GSO of the UNREDUCED q-ary basis (no LLL, no BKZ) at the same (d, k, q), same error vectors, same code path as the real arm
LLL-only tail GSO: the same, after LLL reduction only, no BKZ

a Gaussian-error null of the null: coordinate-aligned projector (t=0) against a Gaussian error at MATCHED VARIANCE instead of CBD.
